Crockpot Pot Roast
By: zestybite
Published: Friday, July 1, 2011 - 9:16am

Ingredients




4 pounds ﻿ Beef Chuck Roast
1 teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Pepper
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
16 ounces package baby carrots
1 onion, chopped
14 ounces Beef Broth
1 teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce
2 tablespoons cornstarch
1/4 cup water

Preparation

1 Mix all liquid ingredients along with salt, pepper and cornstarch in crockpot 2 Place roast in crockpot 3 I also chose to lightly coat roast with more salt, pepper and garlic powder 4 Place onion and carrots all around roast in crockpot 5 Cook for 8-9 hours
